Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive pet personality selection step: Insert a new pet personality customization screen during adoption where users pick temperament traits before generating the certificate. (why: Adoption has a long mean duration of 1017s, and support emails show post-onboarding confusion around pet interactions; selecting personality builds emotional attachment and sets behavior expectations.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign-in screen after waiting progress screen: Move sign-in to occur right after the pet background rendering waiting screen completes. (why: Sign-in conversion drops 23.1% of users; placing sign-in immediately after seeing rendering progress leverages high user motivation right before desktop launch.)
2: [choose_path, new_screen] Add pet genre overview screen before path selection: Insert a preview overview screen before path choice showcasing preset versus custom companion possibilities. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users and has an 8s median / 514s mean duration, indicating users need visual clarity on choices before committing.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Account pet retrieval explicit headline and body: Update sign-in headline and body to explicitly reassure returning users that signing in restores existing pets. (why: The single largest support complaint (8 emails) was users finding their pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [finish, hint] Quick desktop shortcut key hint on home intro: Add a clear shortcut key hint on the home introduction screen explaining how to toggle the pet visible on desktop. (why: Support received multiple complaints from users who could not figure out how to summon, control, or hide their pet after onboarding.)
5: [adoption, incentive] Adoption certificate desktop badge incentive copy: Add an official adoption badge and reward messaging to the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption step takes a mean of 1017s; reinforcing accomplishment with a pet ownership badge boosts completion momentum into final steps.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop launch readiness notification prompt on waiting: Enable desktop readiness notification setting with copy advising users they can minimize the window while waiting. (why: Waiting step mean duration is very high (2336s) and 3 support emails reported pets failing to show on desktop; background notification prevents dropoff.)
